title: Amazonian second-in-command/Quotes
summary:
"These must be your servants."
- Amazonian second-in-command to Sophie Casterwill, about Lok Lambert and Dante Vale (Ladies' Choice)

"Many years ago, when Queen Hippolyta's mother ruled our village, her life was once in danger. She was saved by a Seeker named Metz."
- Amazonian second-in-command to Sophie Casterwill (Ladies' Choice)

"We cannot stop a duel, no matter what. It is Amazon law."
- Amazonian second-in-command to Dante Vale (Ladies' Choice)
